title: 2008 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 1
statement: (Distributive law) Prove that \((x \oplus y) \odot z=x \odot z \oplus y \odot z\) for all \(x, y, z \in \mathbb{R} \cup\{\infty\}\).

solutions.text:
This is equivalent to proving that

\[\min (x, y)+z=\min (x+z, y+z) .\]

Consider two cases. If \(x \leq y\), then \(L H S=x+z\) and \(R H S=x+z\). If \(x>y\), then \(L H S=y+z\) and \(R H S=y+z\). It follows that \(L H S=R H S\).
